about_the_game:
Control a camera that's been lowered deep into a hole.

Your mission is to reach the bottom and reveal what lurks in the depths. But beware—you must evade every threat, natural or unnatural, that could destroy your camera.

This game can be completed using only your mouse.

Move to look around, left-click to descend, and right-click ascend. You can also pause the game by pressing ESC if you want to.

Avoid unnatural threats. Move at the right moment.

A short horror game where you explore a deep hole.

content_descriptors.notes: This game has jumpscares and scary content (Monsters).
